human_pressure.one_screen_brief: 8083 introduced producer-facing capability conformance, but review proved regression_prerequisites is currently indistinguishable from lifecycle: run_started alone marks both evaluable. That is correct for lifecycle because a running lifecycle is evaluable, but misleading for ordered governance regression because improved/regressed requires comparable non-unknown ordered values and real EverRun packages without terminal outcome evidence remain unknown. Correct only the regression_prerequisites contract so producers are told that terminal outcome evidence is still missing. Preserve lifecycle semantics, comparator semantics, source neutrality, package validity behavior and all other capability rules.
human_pressure.why_now: The conformance layer exists specifically to tell producers what evidence blocks governance judgments. Reporting regression_prerequisites=evaluable while outcome is missing_evidence sends the opposite operational signal and prevents the producer contract from closing the long-standing real regression proof gap.
do_not_misread: Lifecycle and regression prerequisites are intentionally different concepts.
A package with run_started only can validly evaluate lifecycle=running while still lacking evidence needed for ordered regression comparison.
This pack does not change the regression comparator or define new transition ordering.
This pack does not require authority, approval, budget, scope or validation evidence for regression prerequisites.
red_lines: Do not change lifecycle evidence requirements.
Do not change src/ailuros/regression/** or projection semantics.
Do not infer terminal outcome from run_started, free-form text, producer identity or unrelated events.
Do not broaden this into a general capability-schema redesign.

machine_core.goal: Make regression_prerequisites report evaluable only when canonical terminal outcome evidence exists, so producer-facing conformance accurately identifies the evidence required for ordered governance regression.
red_lines: Keep lifecycle evaluable from run_started, run_completed or run_failed as currently implemented.
Keep outcome evaluable from run_completed or run_failed as currently implemented.
Regression prerequisites must not be satisfied by run_started alone.
Source/agent/framework metadata must remain outside capability decision logic.
invariants: Package structural validity remains separate from capability evidence sufficiency.
A run_started-only package reports lifecycle=evaluable and regression_prerequisites=missing_evidence.
Either run_completed or run_failed is sufficient terminal outcome evidence for regression_prerequisites.
The same canonical event set yields the same result regardless of producer label.
Comparator behavior and transition ranking remain unchanged.

observable_effect.assertion: Producer-facing regression_prerequisites status distinguishes lifecycle observability from evidence sufficiency for ordered governance regression.

proofs.assertion: A structurally valid package containing run_started but no run_completed/run_failed reports lifecycle=evaluable, outcome=missing_evidence and regression_prerequisites=missing_evidence.
Adding either run_completed or run_failed changes regression_prerequisites to evaluable without requiring unrelated governance dimensions.

The accepted EverRun postfix fixture with no terminal outcome evidence reports regression_prerequisites=missing_evidence and lists run_completed/run_failed as the actionable missing evidence identifiers.
No files under src/ailuros/regression/** or projection.py are changed and existing comparator transition behavior remains covered by the full suite.

failure_semantics: A run_started-only package is not malformed; it remains structurally valid and lifecycle-evaluable while regression prerequisites are missing.
Missing terminal evidence is reported as missing_evidence, not unsupported and not failed.
Unknown or absent terminal outcome must not be converted to comparable success/failure.
Existing real evidence gaps remain visible rather than being hidden by permissive conformance rules.

steps.title: Correct the regression prerequisite specification
details: Change only regression_prerequisites so run_completed OR run_failed satisfies the capability.
Keep precise missing evidence identifiers as run_completed and run_failed when neither is present.
Do not alter lifecycle or outcome specifications.

steps.title: Replace implementation-following expectations with contract tests
details: Update the run_started-only test to assert lifecycle=evaluable, outcome=missing_evidence and regression_prerequisites=missing_evidence.
Add/adjust focused positive cases proving run_completed and run_failed independently satisfy regression_prerequisites.
Update the EverRun postfix fixture expectation to missing_evidence without modifying the fixture itself.

steps.title: Lock the test against a concrete bad mutation
details: Ensure the focused test suite fails if run_started is reintroduced as a sufficient regression_prerequisites alternative.
The guard must exercise evaluate_capability/evaluate_evidence_conformance behavior rather than scan source text.
Do not use cwd-dependent file assertions or inspect.getsource-based checks.

steps.title: Align the producer-facing contract documentation
details: Document that lifecycle observability and ordered-regression comparability are intentionally distinct.
Remove the open issue added during review once the implementation and tests enforce the corrected rule.
Keep the statement bounded: terminal outcome evidence is a prerequisite for ordered outcome comparison, not proof that every governance dimension is comparable.

acceptance: run_started alone keeps lifecycle evaluable but makes regression_prerequisites missing_evidence.
run_completed alone is sufficient for regression_prerequisites.
run_failed alone is sufficient for regression_prerequisites.
EverRun postfix minimal reports regression_prerequisites missing_evidence without fixture mutation.
Missing evidence identifiers are deterministic and actionable.
A concrete reintroduction of run_started as sufficient evidence makes the focused tests fail.
Comparator, projection and other capability semantics are unchanged.
Full pytest, ruff and mypy validation pass.

must_check: Regression prerequisites no longer accept run_started as sufficient evidence.
Lifecycle still accepts run_started and therefore remains independently evaluable for a running execution.
Either canonical terminal event run_completed or run_failed independently satisfies regression_prerequisites.
The real/production-derived EverRun postfix fixture now exposes the terminal evidence gap instead of reporting regression prerequisites evaluable.
Focused tests would fail under the concrete mutation that re-adds run_started to regression_prerequisites alternatives.
No source-specific branch, free-form inference, comparator change or projection change is introduced.
All validation commands pass and forbidden files are untouched.
reject_if: Lifecycle is changed to require terminal evidence.
Regression prerequisites remain equivalent to lifecycle.
run_started is still sufficient for regression_prerequisites.
Terminal evidence is inferred from producer identity, free-form text or unrelated governance events.
The implementation changes regression ranking/transition semantics or projection behavior.
Tests merely mirror implementation without a focused negative case that fails when run_started sufficiency is reintroduced.
Validation fails or forbidden files are modified.
